name: org.antigravityskills/design-skills
title: Design Skills Library
description: Find hand-tested UI/UX design skills for coding agents: verdicts, safety flags, pipelines, installs.

tools.name: design_direction
tools.description: Start here for any page, app screen or UI. Give a one-line brief (product, audience, tone, optional brand color). Returns a complete, ready-to-paste design system: light and dark color tokens with every text/background pair contrast-checked to WCAG AA, CSS variables, a Google Fonts pairing, a type scale, radius and spacing, the layout and hero to build, and the generic patterns to avoid for this kind of product.

product.description: What you are designing, e.g. 'landing page for a free remote MCP server for developers'.

brand_color.description: Optional existing brand color (hex, rgb(), oklch()). The palette is built around it.

tools.name: lint_design
tools.description: Review HTML (and CSS) before shipping. Pass html (inline <style> is read), css, or a public url (the page and its stylesheets are fetched). Returns grouped findings with severity, line and a concrete fix: missing labels/alt/names, heading skips, focus removed, zoom disabled, low contrast (including theme tokens), vw font sizes, transition: all, too many fonts/colors, template copy, and generated-page tells (cream + terracotta, eyebrow labels, gradient washes, card kit, middle dots, 01/02/03). Fix errors, re-run until clean.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch and lint instead of html.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Exact WCAG 2.x contrast ratios for up to 50 foreground/background pairs (hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch(), alpha blended). Returns AA/AAA pass and, for failures, the nearest passing foreground color in the same hue.

tools.name: design_checklist
tools.description: Short, concrete checklist: before-build (brief, tokens, hero, fonts, mobile, states) or pre-launch (lint, contrast, keyboard, 390px, zoom, motion, images, headings, copy, dark mode).

tools.name: find_design_skills
tools.description: Search a curated, hand-tested library of agent skills for UI/UX, frontend, slides, branding, banners, Figma and image work. Describe what you are building; returns the best-matching skills with our hands-on verdict, test result, safety flags and an agent-ready install guide URL. Use before installing a design skill so you pick one that was actually tested.

task.description: What the user wants to design or build, e.g. 'landing page for a fintech app' or 'pitch deck with charts'.

offline.description: Only skills that make no network calls.

no_api_key.description: Exclude skills that need an API key or act in third-party accounts.

tested_only.description: Only skills we ran ourselves (not static review only).

tools.name: get_design_pipeline
tools.description: Return an ordered combination of design skills for a goal (landing page, app dashboard, mobile app, slide deck, brand kit, banners/posters, Figma to code, prototype, generative art, image assets, pre-launch review): which skill to use at each step and why. Pass a free-text goal or one of the pipeline ids.

goal.description: Free text goal or pipeline id (e.g. 'landing-page').

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Full review of one skill by slug: verdict, what we tested and when, good-for / watch-out, safety review, source repo, plus a ready-to-paste install prompt for Google Antigravity and the URL of the agent-readable install guide.

slug.description: Skill slug, e.g. 'ui-ux-pro-max'. Use find_design_skills or list_design_skills to get slugs.

tools.name: list_design_skills
tools.description: Compact list of every design skill in the library (slug, name, one-line purpose, tested or not, safety flags) and all pipeline ids.
